crime: {WITCH_NAME} regularly borrowed books from one reader, agreed with every opinion during their discussions, and became the eager partner the reader wanted. A second reader had recommended another kind of book, and she had claimed that reader's incompatible tastes as her own too.

During midday free time, the second reader joined them in the library and mentioned that different book. The readers compared her claims. The first reader placed both books before her and asked her to choose before either reader offered an opinion. She waited for someone else to answer. The first reader asked for the loaned book back, ended their private book discussions, and told her to leave it in the library before evening free time.

That evening, the second reader followed her into the upper hall and watched from a distance as she carried what appeared to be the loaned book into the library. She left empty-handed and went downstairs without noticing. The reader stayed by the library entrance to meet the first reader before they went to the recreation room.

The second reader saw no one enter before the first reader arrived and opened the library door. A crossbow bolt struck the first reader in the chest and killed her. The second reader rushed inside at once. There was no shooter or visible crossbow, and no one had escaped past the second reader. Only the apparent loaned book lay where the bolt had come from, suggesting that a hidden attacker had fired from inside and taken the weapon.

When the second reader lifted the apparent book, its weight and the rigid shape beneath the image did not feel like a book. By touch, the reader found the stock, bow, and door trigger of the fired lounge crossbow, still aimed at the doorway. The reader had seen her carry that same object inside and leave without it, then had guarded the entrance until the shot. This proved that she had used Mimicry to disguise the crossbow as the returned book and leave a delayed trap. The disguise remained after she let go and changed only what the crossbow looked like, so it could still fire normally.
fields.epitaph: Under the glass, every borrowed answer falls away.
execution: A massive transparent glass slab hangs above her. She is restrained face-up on the execution stand directly beneath it.

The slab descends without stopping. Everyone can see her through it as it lowers onto her entire body and presses her against the stand. It crushes her skull, shoulders, chest, ribs, pelvis, and spine. The slab comes to rest on her flattened corpse, which remains fully visible through the glass.

magic.name: Mimicry
magic.text: She can make an object she touches look like another object she can see.
